description:
Query-plan capture was added/expanded across ~20 platforms this month and is
the area where escaped defects cluster - the PR review follow-up sweeps repeatedly
fixed plan-capture parser/wiring bugs after merge (e.g. #824 Azure Synapse DAG
and QuestDB cursor AttributeError, #862 wrong executed_sql, #894 Spark parser
accepting an EXPLAIN-failure sentinel and ClickHouse parser not registered).

Yet a grep of .github/workflows/ for plan_capture / capture_plans / query-plan
returns NOTHING (re-confirmed on develop @ cb49cecf5, 2026-06-28:
`grep -rl 'plan_capture\|capture_plans\|query-plan' .github/workflows/` -> no
match). Plan-capture correctness rides only on the fast unit suite and a
non-blocking (continue-on-error: true, excluded from ci-required-result) postgres
integration sample. The cross-surface correctness gates ARE wired and required
(pr.yml:369 correctness-gate, in the ci-required-result needs list at :637) -
plan capture is the conspicuous gap.

Add a small, fast, in-process plan-capture gate (DuckDB + SQLite, no service
container, no credentials) that runs the isolated capture phase end-to-end and
asserts: each result carries a parsed plan, fingerprints are stable across runs,
and DML statements are not double-executed. Wire it as a BLOCKING job in pr.yml.

anti_patterns.dont: fork the capture pipeline for the gate
anti_patterns.why: drive run_plan_capture_phase / the production path the real run uses.

anti_patterns.dont: require a database service container or credentials
anti_patterns.why: the gate must run on a bare CI runner.

preserves.behavior: Routine PRs stay cheap: the gate is in-process (DuckDB+SQLite), no service containers, no secrets, fast-marked.
The non-blocking postgres/datafusion/clickhouse equivalence SAMPLES (continue-on-error) are unchanged; this adds coverage, it does not make samples blocking.

prior_art.concept: {'ref': '.github/workflows/pr.yml:369', 'note': 'correctness-gate job - the model for a new required gate job; add the plan-capture job beside it and into the ci-required-result needs list (:637).'}
{'ref': 'Makefile', 'note': 'ssb-cross-surface-equivalence-report and the other *-report targets are the template for a new `plan-capture-gate` make target.'}
{'ref': 'tests/integration/test_plan_capture_phase.py', 'note': 'Existing E2E capture-phase test; the gate should drive the same run_plan_capture_phase path rather than a bespoke one.'}

{'ref': 'tests/unit/platforms/test_duckdb_plan_capture.py, test_sqlite_plan_capture.py', 'note': 'Existing per-platform in-process capture tests - reuse their fixtures/engines for a credential-free gate.'}
{'ref': 'tests/unit/query_plans/test_fingerprint_hygiene.py', 'note': "Existing fingerprint-stability assertions to fold into the gate's stability check."}

verifications.expected: DuckDB and SQLite capture E2E pass; fingerprints stable; no DML double-execution
job defined AND present in the ci-required-result needs list (not continue-on-error)

work_units.notes:
New Makefile target invoking a focused pytest selection (or a small driver)
that, for DuckDB and SQLite: runs a bounded benchmark with capture_plans
through the production run pipeline, asserts every result row has a parsed
plan, asserts fingerprint stability across two runs, and asserts a DML/CTAS
statement executed exactly once (no double-execution). Reuse the existing
in-process plan-capture tests and run_plan_capture_phase; do not fork the
capture path. Keep it credential-free and fast (no postgres service).
work_units.summary: Add a make plan-capture-gate target that runs an in-process DuckDB+SQLite capture E2E with assertions

work_units.notes:
Add a plan-capture-gate job to .github/workflows/pr.yml modeled on
correctness-gate, and add it to the ci-required-result needs list (pr.yml:637)
and its status echo (:694). It must NOT be continue-on-error. Confirm it is a
hard blocker by checking the aggregator logic.
work_units.summary: Wire plan-capture-gate as a BLOCKING pr.yml job in ci-required-result

work_units.notes:
Demonstrate the gate FAILS when a plan-capture defect is planted (e.g. a
parser that returns a sentinel-as-plan, or a fingerprint that leaks a
cost/cardinality field), mirroring the planted-divergence proof the
cross-surface gates use. Capture the before/after in the PR body.
work_units.summary: Prove the gate catches a planted plan-capture defect (no silent green)
